 \\\\                            Malice Rewards                           \\\\
  \\\\_____________________________________________________________________\\\\
   ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Listed here are the prizes you win after defeating your Malice in the
Graveyard. The prize you win depends on the level of Malice you have
accumulated, with 100 being the max value. Sadly you can't use this knowledge
to get the special prizes again and again, as they are replaced with a Thera
Leaf the second time you clear the Malice at the same value.

     .———————————.————————————————————.  .———————————.————————————————————.
     |  Malice   |  Prize             |——|  Malice   |  Prize             |
     |===========|====================|/\|===========|====================|
     |  01 - 03  |  Thera Leaf        |\/|  57 - 59  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |       04  |  Seal of Wisdom    |/\|       60  |  Seal of Speed     |
     |  05 - 06  |  Mana Leaf         |\/|  61 - 62  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |       07  |  Key to Success    |/\|       63  |  Seal of Power     |
     |  08 - 09  |  Pure Leaf         |\/|  64 - 65  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |  10 - 14  |  Thera Leaf        |/\|  66 - 69  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |  15 - 19  |  Mana Leaf         |\/|       70  |  Seal of Life      |
     |  20 - 24  |  Pure Leaf         |/\|  71 - 73  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |       25  |  Seal of Vitality  |\/|  74 - 76  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |  26 - 29  |  Thera Leaf        |/\|       77  |  Seventh Key       |
     |  30 - 34  |  Mana Leaf         |\/|  78 - 79  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |       35  |  Silver Hand       |/\|  80 - 83  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |  36 - 39  |  Pure Leaf         |\/|       84  |  Seal of Aura      |
     |  40 - 41  |  Thera Leaf        |/\|  85 - 87  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |       42  |  Kirin Scale       |\/|  88 - 90  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |  43 - 44  |  Mana Leaf         |/\|       91  |  Monkey Paw        |
     |  45 - 49  |  Pure Leaf         |\/|  92 - 93  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |       50  |  Seal of the Soul  |/\|  94 - 97  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |  51 - 52  |  Thera Leaf        |\/|       98  |  Seal of Luck      |
     |  53 - 55  |  Mana Leaf         |/\|       99  |  Dice of Caesar    |
     |       56  |  Seal of Force     |\/|      100  |  N/A               |
